summary.en: Syrian forces are preparing to send troops to Saudi Arabia to support the war against the Houthis, while publicly denying any presence in Yemen. Security forces in Aleppo have dismantled ISIS cells, freeing a kidnapping victim and arresting members, and Syrian authorities have also arrested four suspects in a separate cell. The Syrian defense minister and a regional commander held talks on security, and Syrian officials discussed climate security and financing on the sidelines of COP31. The conflict caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Syriske styrker forbereder å sende tropper til Saudi-Arabia for å støtte krigen mot houthiene, samtidig som de offentlig benekter enhver tilstedeværelse i Jemen. Sikkerhetsstyrker i Aleppo har oppløst IS-celler, frigjort et kidnappingsoffer og arrestert medlemmer, og syriske myndigheter har også arrestert fire mistenkte i en separat celle. Den syriske forsvarsministeren og en regional kommandør holdt sikkerhetssamtaler, og syriske tjenestemenn diskuterte klima- og sikkerhetsfinansiering på sidelinjen av COP31. Konflikten forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
